attBesluta.text: ★★★★★ Great addition to my home gym I’ve been using this on almost every workout since I got it, and it’s easily one of the best purchases I’ve made for my home gym. Having two pulleys is a game changer because I can switch between exercises quickly without constantly reconfiguring everything. The setup is easy to adjust, the pulleys operate great, and it feels smooth and consistent. For the price, the quality exceeded my expectations. If you’re building a home gym and want a versatile cable system that gets used every lift, I’d definitely recommend this one.

I am not going to lie, I was skeptic with how cheap this pulley system was but once using it now for 4 weeks, this thing is awesome and a steal at that price! If you are wanting to add cable pulls to your home gym workouts, buy this product! It is well built, easy to use, and lots of attachments. Buy now and thank me later!

I was worried about assembling a projector stand without instructions in my native language, but this one has instructions in all major EU languages, including mine! It made the assembly process so easy, I had it together in less than 15 minutes, no help needed. The stand itself is very well made, the steel frame is sturdy and stable, my projector sits on it perfectly, no wobble at all. The height adjustment is smooth and easy to use, I can set it to the perfect height for my screen and seating position. The two shelves are very useful, I can keep all my accessories on the lower shelf, so everything is in one place. The wheels are great for moving it between rooms, and the brakes work really well. It's perfect for use anywhere in the EU, the universal power adapter (if needed) works in all EU countries, and the design fits in with any home decor. I'm very happy with this purchase, I'd recommend it to anyone in the EU looking for an easy-to-use, reliable projector stand!
